content: Dameŋ ira opâ ruac guru sâko embiŋte nânâ bârâwiŋne-jarehuc Grië opâ ruac jaŋere hozec bâtiric-jopapie Juda opâ ruac jaŋere manapie mi sâckeme dâŋ bâfuambiŋ.
Iŋuc epie aposolo 12 jaŋe opâ ruac hetumaŋ-jopa-fârerâ šiŋuc jazambiŋ: “Nâŋe sahackopec gie i dopeckehuc Anuture dâŋ mumu irec gie behepene wahame mi sâckeocmu.
Irec ŋic âgofâc, ŋoŋe ŋic 7 ŋaŋacne ŋondeŋko Mâro â mamanahec jupie honec-jopapie sâckeme rowosâec-jopanšepieŋ. Eme nâŋe gie i mujarepene banšepieŋ.
Nâŋe ine nunumu â miti mumu irec gie paŋšâic jaha banšepeneŋ.”

Dâŋ iŋuc mupie opâ ruac jaŋe manapie sâcke-fârewec. Ehuc ŋic šiŋuc bâwosâec-jopambiŋ: Stefano, e maŋnao mamanasiŋ â Tiri Mâro fufusuc fowec, erâ Filipo â Porokoro â Nikano â Timoŋ â Pamena â Nikolao, e Antiokia haeonec ŋic qâpuczi Judaŋic jaŋerao šuhuckewec.
Eme ŋic i hâcne jaŋe aposolo jaŋere maŋfuŋko birickerâ domapie mejeŋic qizec-jeŋicko râehuc numu jambuŋ ejarembiŋ.
Eme Anuture dâŋzi haŋ bahuc fome Jesure kikefuŋ jaŋerao denaŋne denaŋne šuhuckeme šuhuc erambiŋ. Erâ taha bapa jaŋeraonec wâc bocjahazi miti mana rereŋ embiŋ.
Stefano e miti â tâpiri bocjaha focnewecte ŋic jaŋerao mâsi fuŋne fuŋne bawec.
Eme Hotâonec mujarembiŋ ŋic i jaŋere mitificko tumaŋne jumbieŋ, jaŋeraonec ŋic gâcne â Kirene ŋic â Alesandria ŋic â Kilikia ŋic â Asia ŋic, iŋuczi qâturerâ Stefano mu qatarac ecnembiŋ.
Eme e dâŋ mana utuckehuc Mârohec mume jaŋere dâŋzi firorieme eipiecnembiŋ.
Eipierâ ŋic qafeŋ-jopapie jaŋe Stefanore šiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Ŋic e Mose â Anutu musoriŋ-jofame manambeŋ.”
Iŋuc ehuc ŋic omane â soŋaŋ â miti qaqazu mu âke ɋâfoŋ ejarembiŋ. Erâ Stefano somâckerâ hâporâ micne guru tutumaŋko barambiŋ.
Ehuc dâŋ qanaŋ bâmockerâ âgofâc-jeŋic jarepie bajumbiŋ jaŋe ejarepie Stefanore burec ehuc šiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Ŋic e tiri ufuŋ â sâcmutâc dâŋnâŋec surehuc juekac.
Nâŋe kecšiŋuc mume manambeŋ: `Jesu Nazarete haeonec eki hâcne ufuŋ ši ima qahuc sâcmutâc dâŋ Mosezi mufua-nârewec i hetâtieocmu. Ž ”
Eme tutumaŋko ŋembiŋ ŋic i jaŋe Stefanorao firâ râqârehuc šâŋe maine honepie aŋelo hawari tinac ewec.
